name: Counting On
description: Follow the next generation of Duggars as they celebrate some of life’s milestone moments, including the realities of growing up and raising their own families.

videos.title: A Baby Girl for Jessa Part 2

videos.overview: Find out how the family stays on track, including surprising stats!

videos.title: How to Have a Duggar Wedding
videos.overview: See what it takes to pull off a perfect Duggar-sized wedding.

videos.title: Babies on Board
videos.overview: Take a look at the memorable births the family has shared over the years.

videos.title: Another Girl for Jinger
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy are preparing for the birth of their second daughter.

videos.title: At Home & Away
videos.overview: Jessa and Ben navigate life as a family of three with their new baby; Jill and Derick settle into their home in Central America; Jessa enlists her sisters to help prepare a fall feast for the whole family.

videos.title: Date Nights & Bright Lights
videos.overview: Jana and Jessa embark on a lighting project while the rest of the family travels to Central America; Jessa and Ben go on their first date since Spurgeon was born.

videos.title: Jinger Flips
videos.overview: Jessa goes out for coffee with Jana and Anna, leaving Ben in charge of Spurgeon; Jinger buys a car at auction; Jana starts a new project with her brothers; Jill and Derick introduce Israel to their love of pickles.

videos.title: Surprise!
videos.overview: The siblings continue building the tree house, which gets bigger and bigger; Joy and Sierra secretly plan a surprise baby shower; Jill and Derick have surprise guests in Central America.

videos.title: Ben Drops Beats
videos.overview: Work on the tree house continues, but cold weather hampers the family's efforts. Meanwhile, Ben and Jessa go to St. Louis to meet with Christian rapper Flame, and inspiration sends Ben into the recording booth.

videos.title: Girls Hit the Road
videos.overview: The girls hit the road for a weekend getaway, but encounter an unexpected detour on the way to their destination. Meanwhile, the tree house is ready for a big unveiling after weeks of work.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: Jessa, Ben and Spurgeon travel to Central America to visit Jill, Derick and Israel.  As they prepare for the trip, they travel down memory lane, revisiting Jessa's milestone moments, from engagement to motherhood, that have led to this emotional reunion.

videos.title: Israel Meets Spurgeon
videos.overview: Jessa and Ben experience what life is like in a foreign country with a young son; Jill and Derick remember their beginnings together in Nepal and the adventures that have led them to Central America.

videos.title: A Courtship Begins
videos.overview: In the Season 2 premiere, mission work continues for Jill and Derick in Central America; Jessa and Ben talk about their growing family; and Jinger shares big news about her future.

videos.title: Duggars in the Wild
videos.overview: Wilderness training continues for the Duggar siblings following a frightening encounter with a nocturnal visitor. Meanwhile, Jill and Derick celebrate their second anniversary; and Jessa and Ben are amazed by how fast Spurgeon is growing.

videos.title: A Big Surprise
videos.overview: Jeremy takes a secret trip to Arkansas, where he and Ben browse for engagement rings before surprising Jinger. Later, Jessa and Ben introduce rapper Flame to the Duggar clan.

videos.title: The Big Event
videos.overview: Ben hosts a football camp for kids with help from some former NFL players. Meanwhile, Jana sets out to redecorate the guesthouse for Jill and Derick when they come home from Central America; and Jinger and Jeremy plan a trip to New York City.

videos.title: Guys' Guide to Courting
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy go on a whirlwind trip to see his family and friends; a look back at past Duggar courtships, with tips from the guys for a successful relationship.

videos.title: Proposal in the City
videos.overview: Jinger, Michelle, Jessa, Ben and Spurgeon meet Jeremy's family and friends while visiting his old stomping grounds, culminating with an important question he wants to ask Jinger.

videos.title: The After Show
videos.overview: The family comes together to relive some of the most memorable moments from season two, and a surprise guest makes an appearance.

videos.title: Duggars at the Altar
videos.overview: A look back at the Duggar daughter marriages, when Jill and Jessa walked down the aisle just months apart.

videos.title: The Jinger Gown
videos.overview: Jinger said yes to marrying Jeremy and now it's time to start planning for the big day, which is just 3 months away! The family takes a trip to DC to find Jinger's perfect dress. But with more options than imagined, will she find the dress of her dreams?

videos.title: Could It be Twins?
videos.overview: Jessa and Ben listen to the heartbeat of Baby #2, which makes them wonder if it's twins. They travel to see friend Flame in concert, and Ben takes center stage. Jinger continues with wedding planning and finalizes important details.

videos.title: All About Jinger
videos.overview: Jinger packs for her move to Texas, which includes a surprise gift from her family, before she, Jeremy and Jed drive to her future home; the siblings take a trip down memory lane by remembering Jinger through the years.

videos.title: The Big Day
videos.overview: After months of planning, Jinger's wedding day has arrived and the final details, from dress fittings to surprise decorations, are put into place as family and friends come together to celebrate the new Mr. and Mrs. Vuolo.

videos.title: A Honeymoon and a Courtship
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy have said "I do," and now the newlyweds finally get to enjoy some alone time. Mr. and Mrs. Vuolo head down under for their honeymoon in Australia. Meanwhile, back in Arkansas, another Duggar enters a courtship.

videos.title: Joy's Wedding
videos.overview: Joy and Austin's wedding day is finally here; a first look at this exciting and emotional event, with Joy walking down the aisle to become Mrs. Austin Forsyth; another Duggar has a surprise that leaves guests shocked.

videos.title: Triple Date Night
videos.overview: Ben, Derick and Austin enjoy an afternoon at a trampoline park while Jessa, Jill and Joy shop for the perfect date night outfit. Jill and Derick share some big news with Israel. Meanwhile in Laredo, Jinger and Jeremy settle into married life.

videos.title: Spurgeon's First Birthday
videos.overview: Joy and Austin work together on a house flipping project; the family celebrates Spurgeon's first birthday; in Laredo, things heat up in the kitchen with Jinger and Jeremy

videos.title: A New Baby
videos.overview: As Jessa's due date inches closer, family and friends help the Seewalds prepare for the new baby. Joy and Austin continue working on their house flipping project, and Austin asks Jim Bob an important question. Later, Jessa and Ben welcome their 2nd child.

videos.title: A Boy or Girl for Jill?
Joy Gets Engaged
videos.overview: Jinger makes a care package for the family back in Arkansas. Meanwhile, the Dillards prepare to return to Central America; Austin has an important question for Joy; and Joe asks for permission to enter a courtship with Kendra.

videos.title: The After Show, Part 1
videos.overview: Host Daphne Oz digs a little deeper into some of the season's biggest moments, from courtships and weddings to babies.

videos.title: The After Show Part 2
videos.overview: Host Daphne Oz gets the Duggars’ reactions to some of the biggest moments of the season; the couples square off in a fun game of “The Couples Showdown”; a special guest or two show up.

videos.title: A New Courtship
videos.overview: The Seewalds and the Vuolos meet up in San Antonio and take a stroll down memory lane; Joy begins her wedding planning with a walkthrough of the venue; the Dillards get settled in Central America; Joe asks Kendra an important question.

videos.title: Let Them Eat Cake
videos.overview: Wedding planning continues as Joy shops for bridesmaids dresses and tastes cakes with Austin; Joe and Kendra enjoy a rollerblading date; the Vuolos take a cooking class together; renovations begin on Joy and Austin's house.

videos.title: Finding Joy's Dress
videos.overview: Joy travels to Kentucky to find her perfect wedding dress, but with so many options, the overwhelmed bride has to make some big decisions; Austin and Joe enjoy some bonding time with their future father-in-laws; Israel celebrates his second birthday.

videos.title: Joy and Austin's Camping Trip
videos.overview: Joy and Kendra visit a salon to get some hairstyle ideas for Joy's wedding; Joy and Austin celebrate their bachelor and bachelorette weekend with a fun camping trip; Jinger and Jeremy do some shopping for Joy and Austin's rehearsal dinner.

videos.title: Tomboy Joy
videos.overview: Joy and Austin's wedding day is coming up fast, so her siblings prepare some special gifts for the happy couple while taking a trip down memory lane remembering Joy through the years.

videos.title: Joy and Austin Tie the Knot
videos.overview: Joy's wedding day arrives after months of planning, and the final touches are added as family and friends come together to celebrate the new Mr. and Mrs. Forsyth.

videos.title: Joseph's Wedding
videos.overview: The day has finally arrived for Joe and Kendra to get married, and Kendra walks down the aisle to become Mrs. Joseph Duggar; a few surprises may be in store for the happy couple.

videos.title: In Love in Switzerland
videos.overview: Joy and Austin have said I do, and now Mr. and Mrs. Forsyth finally get to enjoy some alone time in Switzerland. .

videos.title: The Vuolos Buy a House
videos.overview: The siblings help Jinger and Jeremy move into their new house.

videos.title: Spurgeon's First Haircut
videos.overview: Jeremy and Jinger continue to put their stamp on their new home; Joe and Kendra pick out the groomsmen's outfits; Jessa and Ben finally give Spurgeon a haircut; and Joy and Austin try to make the most of their less-than-ideal living situation.

videos.title: A New Bundle of Joy
videos.overview: Joy and Austin have big news to share with the family.

videos.title: Joe and Kendra Say I Do
videos.overview: The time has finally come for Joe and Kendra to say I do; there are emotional moments with family and friends as they prepare for their wedding day; when the ceremony begins, a few surprises and mishaps make sure it's a day they won't forget.

videos.title: It's All Greek to Me!
videos.overview: In this first look at Josiah and Lauren's wedding, the bride and groom say their "I do's" and have their first kiss. Meanwhile, Joe and Kendra go on their honeymoon in Greece.

videos.title: Make Room for Baby
videos.overview: Joy and Austin check in on Baby Forsyth at their midwife appointment. In Laredo, Jinger and Jeremy go window shopping for a new piano. Joe and Kendra move into their new home and have a special reveal for the family.

videos.title: Unexpected
videos.overview: Newly-expectant parents Joe & Kendra check up on their baby. The little girls record an album in Nashville. Josiah takes Lauren's siblings out for ice cream. While visiting Jeremy's parents at a charity gala, he & Jinger reveal some unexpected news.

videos.title: Jinger and Jeremy's Secret
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy are ready for their first baby’s arrival, and she heads to the hospital, but when progress is slow, there’s worry she might have to have a C-section.

videos.title: An Explosive Reveal
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy celebrate their first anniversary, and Jeremy has a very special surprise for her. Josiah is ready to take the next step and hopes for Lauren’s dad’s blessing. Later, Joe and Kendra reveal the gender of their baby in a very explosive way.

videos.title: Josiah Pops the Question
videos.overview: Josiah travels to Georgia to propose to Lauren; Jinger and Jeremy’s friends come for a visit, and the expecting couple has a trial run at parenthood.

videos.title: A Birth-Day and a Birthday
videos.overview: The three pregnant sisters are reunited for a big family birthday. Later, Joy goes into labor, and after 20 hours, she is transported to the hospital for an emergency C-section.

videos.title: Thrift Store Date Night
videos.overview: Three couples go on a thrift store date night and choose outfits for their partners to wear, but with a small budget and a big sense of humor, someone may end up with a fashion faux pas. Then, new mom Joy and pregnant Kendra have a joint Sip & See party.

videos.title: Lauren Finds Her Dress
videos.overview: The Duggars celebrate Jana and John David’s 28th birthday with a family ski trip. Meanwhile, Jinger and Jeremy tour a birth center and find out the gender of their baby; and Lauren goes shopping for the perfect wedding gown.

videos.title: Jinger's Double Surprise
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy throw a gender reveal party for the family and the family has a surprise of their own for Jinger; Josiah and Lauren celebrate their upcoming wedding with a game of giant foosball; and Joe and Kendra welcome their baby boy.

videos.title: Kendra Has a Baby
videos.overview: Jessa, Joe, Joy and their spouses throw a “Dinner Around the World” potluck and cook dishes from their honeymoon destinations. Josiah & Lauren celebrate their upcoming wedding with a game of giant foosball. Later, Joe & Kendra welcome their baby boy!

videos.title: Josiah & Lauren's Wedding
videos.overview: It’s Josiah and Lauren’s wedding day, and the happy couple is eager to walk down the aisle and finally share their first kiss. But with Josiah being the family prankster and the brothers out for revenge, the couple are in for some shenanigans.

videos.title: Love Is in the Air
videos.overview: With the due date near, Jinger and Jeremy get ready to meet baby Vuolo; John whisks Abbie away on a surprise trip to ask for her hand in marriage; Jinger's labor takes an unexpected turn.

videos.title: Jinger Has a Baby
videos.overview: The hills are alive for Josiah and Lauren as they go on their Austrian honeymoon; while there, they re-enact scenes from "The Sound of Music" and visit with a local family; Jinger worries she won't have the smooth labor she was hoping for.

videos.title: Sleepless in Laredo
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy get a dose of reality as they adjust to life as new parents; Ben tutors the Duggar kids and they must use their math skills to cook a meal for 40 people; later at dinner, one couple makes a special announcement.

videos.title: Love and Loss
videos.overview: Jessa, Lauren, Kendra and Jana pair off with some of the little kids and go head to head to create a groom's cake for John and Abbie's wedding; Josiah and Lauren's worlds are shaken up when they reveal some tragic news.

videos.title: The Abbie Gown
videos.overview: In Laredo, Jeremy is on daddy duty as Jinger runs errands. Meanwhile, John & Abbie's wedding is just around the corner! John and the boys partake in a thrilling competition while Abbie tries on wedding dresses. Will Abbie be able to find "the one?"

videos.title: To Grandmother's House We Go
videos.overview: John David and Abbie fly to the Philippines for a mission trip weeks before their wedding; Jinger and Jeremy travel up north so Felicity can meet her great-grandparents; while there, they get a surprise from some very unexpected guests.

videos.title: A Bachelor No More
videos.overview: John and Abbie's wedding is finally here and everyone is in full wedding-mode as they get ready for the big day; at the altar, the bride and groom share their first kiss in an unexpected way; a family member has a very special announcement.

videos.title: Who's the Most Romantic?
videos.overview: The couples compete to see who can come up with the most-romantic date.

videos.title: The Vuolos Take LA
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy explore LA, and the Duggar boys go on a road trip.

videos.title: Count Your Blessings
videos.overview: Jinger visits Grandma Duggar. Lauren opens up about grief and depression.

videos.title: Kendra's Got a Secret
videos.overview: Kendra surprises Joe when she finds out she's expecting baby number 2!

videos.title: The Great Duggar Campout
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy go house hunting in LA but with pricier real estate and small square footage, will they be able to find the perfect place? Meanwhile in Arkansas, the family is going camping. Later at dinner, one couple makes a special announcement.

videos.title: Baby Number Two, But Who?
videos.overview: Joe & Kendra visit Jinger & Jeremy in Texas, where they sample creepy, crawly appetizers. Jessa seeks help from a speech therapist as Henry struggles to learn new words. Joy & Austin surprise the family by announcing that they are expecting baby #2!

videos.title: Marriage Bootcamp
videos.overview: Ginger & Jeremy decide to hold a yard sale before their big move to LA. They must put their haggling skills to work and try to sell as much as they can. Meanwhile, the married couples attend a marriage retreat where they focus on their relationships.

videos.title: Five Pregnancies and Counting
videos.overview: Five Duggars are pregnant! The ladies attend a garden party to celebrate. Ben & Jessa take a trip down memory lane five years after their engagement. Josiah & Lauren are concerned when their gender reveal balloon floats away. Jessa goes into labor.

videos.title: A Surprise Delivery
videos.overview: Jessa goes into labor two weeks before her due date and after the birth, they are faced with an emergency situation. Joe and Kendra find out the gender of their second baby with a smashing reveal. Then, another Duggar reveals she's expecting.

videos.title: Grandma Duggar Remembered
videos.overview: The four pregnant Duggar girls and Jessa have a maternity photoshoot and a surprise guest reveals she's also expecting. Jinger and Jeremy prepare for their big move to LA but tragedy strikes when they get devastating news from back home.

videos.title: La La Land
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy are getting ready to start their new lives in LA.

videos.title: Beverly Hills Duggars
videos.overview: Jana and Jinger have sticker shock while shopping in Beverly Hills.

videos.title: A Duggar Bachelor Pad
videos.overview: Jessa and Ben go on their first road trip with three kids; some of the Duggars go to the Bahamas to help after a hurricane; Jed and Jere show off their bachelor pad; the family competes in a corn maze race.

videos.title: The Duggar Dash
videos.overview: It's hard to decide which Duggar is the most competitive, so they decide to put it to a test; the family splits into four teams and Michelle sends them on an exciting race around town.

videos.title: A Baby Girl for Joe and Kendra
videos.overview: Jeremy takes a skateboarding lesson with ex-pro skateboarder Brian Sumner. Will he learn to shred or play it safe? Later, Kendra goes into labour. As contractions intensify quickly, her birth team worries that her doctor might not arrive in time.

videos.title: A Beautiful Miracle
videos.overview: Lauren goes into labor 11 days before her due date; she and Josiah can’t wait to meet their baby; Jinger and Jeremy join Family Fun Night in Arkansas via video chat, where they share a special surprise.

videos.title: Highs and Lows
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy share the sad news that they have miscarried their baby; in Arkansas, Ben has second thoughts as he undergoes eye surgery; Jeremy throws Jinger a surprise party filled with some unexpected guests and a special gift.

videos.title: Best Duggar Christmas Pageant
videos.overview: Jana and Jessa organize a Christmas pageant, and the whole family pitches in to pull it off, including Jim Bob, who has a very special role; Jinger and Jeremy cut down their first live Christmas tree together.

videos.title: Meet Gracie Duggar
videos.overview: John David goes from bachelor till the rapture to dad; he prepares for the arrival of his first child by making a video for Abbie; Abbie goes into labor, but it’s deemed a false alarm; after laboring overnight, she and John meet their daughter.

videos.title: From Snow to Sand
videos.overview: Jinger and Jeremy take advantage of all California has to offer when they take friends on a snow to sand adventure. Back in Arkansas, the guys throw John a Dad-chelor party to welcome him to fatherhood. Then, Joy and Austin share exciting news.

videos.title: Jana's Secret Garden
videos.overview: Jana does so much for the family that they want to surprise her with something she's wanted for a long time; John, Abbie and baby Gracie keep Jana distracted in Tennessee while the rest of the family hustles to pull off this big surprise.

videos.title: A Quarantine Courtship
videos.overview: The Duggars get creative with celebrating Abbie's birthday while maintaining social distancing; Jinger and Jeremy share a happy surprise with the family over video chat; someone announces they have entered a courtship.
